rule: Test-dev is evaluated exactly once with the systems below. No system, parameter or selection may change after any test-dev metric is seen. Any post-hoc bug fix must be documented as a correction with both results reported.
evaluation: custom class-agnostic internal protocol (NOT official VisDrone): HOTA TrackEval 12c8791; MOTA/IDF1/IDS/FP/FN/P/R motmetrics 1.4.0
primary_comparison: UniversalACMOT_v3 (ByteTrack) vs each baseline, per detector, paired sequence bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 42) of pooled HOTA, IDF1, MOTA

systems.default: raw scores, res 640, ByteTrack ultralytics defaults (0.25/0.1/0.25, buffer 30, match 0.8)
systems.shared_static_832: raw threshold 0.5 (low 0.1, new 0.5), res 832, buffer 30, match 0.8 — best single shared raw setting on val
systems.shared_static_736: same, res 736 (compute-matched to the AC resolution usage)
systems.oracle: detector-specific reference selected on val: yolov8 res 832 high 0.4; rtdetr res 832 high 0.5 (low=min(0.1,high/2), new=high)
systems.universal_v1_superseded: V1 base + raw ratio gate rho 0.6, feedback accepted (tag universal-acmot-v1-freeze)
systems.V3_ecdf_ratio06: ECDF normalizer + raw ratio gate rho 0.6 (ablation)

trackers.botsort: default, shared_static_832, V3 (tracker-portability, no policy change)

superseded_by: research/TESTDEV_LOCK_V4.json (whole-model generalization audit, Amendment 4). No test-dev metric was computed under this lock.
